# SeniorTalk

> SeniorTalk is a 24/7 AI companion platform designed specifically for elderly people, offering multilingual conversational AI, voice calling, and messaging across WhatsApp, SMS, and Facebook Messenger.

SeniorTalk provides accessible technology solutions for senior wellness and combating social isolation through personalized AI companions. The platform serves individual users, senior living facilities, and care homes across multiple countries with multilingual support.

## Key Topics

- AI companion
